text.en:
The municipality of Dulawan shall have its present ter-
ritory minus the portion thereof included in the munic-
ipality of Norala.
The municipality of Norala shall be organized and begin
to exist upon certification by the Provincial Treasurer that
the new municipality possesses the financial capacity to
pay its officials and emplovees the minimum salaries and
wages in accordance with the provisions of Republic 'Act
No. 602 and upor. the appointment and qualifiaction of the
mayor, vice-mayor and a majority of the councilors thereof.
Done in tha City of Manila, this 10th day of March, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-three,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the seventh.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Frecutive Secretary
